demand: Recover Koios's paid newsroom prior art, reconcile it with authoritative modern digital-journalism practice, and induce only the duties needed by the live production circuit.

authorities.name: Society of Professional Journalists Code of Ethics
obligations: verify before release and prefer original sources
provide context and avoid oversimplification in promotion and summaries
identify sources and consider their motives
seek response from subjects of criticism
distinguish news from advertising
correct promptly and prominently
explain methods and ethical choices

authorities.name: Reuters Journalistic Standards
obligations: hold accuracy sacrosanct
seek fair comment
correct transparently
disclose conflicts
avoid unattributed opinion, fabrication, plagiarism, sensationalism, and hype
label fact-based news separately from opinion and analysis

authorities.name: Associated Press News Values and Principles
obligations: vet Internet material and attribute the original source
treat generative output as unvetted source material
distinguish correlation from causation in data work
label corrections and propagate them to consumer and subscriber surfaces

authorities.name: Associated Press Standards Around Generative AI
obligations: apply editorial judgment and sourcing standards to model output
do not infer authenticity from realistic appearance
identify original sources and corroborating reports
withhold doubtful material

authorities.name: IPTC NewsML-G2 and ninjs
obligations: carry news as versioned exchange items and packages
identify workflow actors and item relationships
separate verification and authorization for release
preserve interoperable metadata across text, image, video, audio, and downstream transmissions

authorities.name: The Trust Project Trust Indicators
obligations: disclose ownership, mission, standards, ethics, and conflicts
identify journalist expertise
label news, analysis, opinion, and paid work distinctly
show references and methods
make corrections policy visible

authorities.name: News Product Alliance 2025 Census
obligations: join editorial ethics, audience need, revenue, and technology through cross-functional product decisions
measure the audience experience without converting demand into evidence

settledTopology.newswire: A separately hireable source-stream enterprise that fetches and witnesses source items with provenance; no consuming newsroom owns its internal fetching apparatus.
settledTopology.newscable: A separately hireable collection and routing enterprise that composes admitted newswires into topic and delivery surfaces; it does not grant publication warrant.
settledTopology.koiosNews: Contracts newswire and newscable services, admits returned evidence into its own corpus, and runs a Koios-owned MAPE-K editorial loop over that local knowledge.
settledTopology.conglomerateResearch: A separately contractable contextual corpus whose already-paid analysis may enrich assignments and explanation, while remaining distinct from fresh Web evidence and sharing its production cost across lawful consumers.

inducedCircuit.duty: Turn audience/search demand and source events into a bounded reporting question and genre without treating demand as evidence or exact-match copy.
Acquire adequate original reporting, preserve full usable text and source roles, test coherence and source power, and request more reporting instead of commissioning unsupported prose.
Realize one admitted reporting packet into attributed prose while preserving modality, source boundaries, genre, and the right to refuse thin reporting.
Judge manuscript plus sources and production trace; on failure locate the earliest causal layer, prescribe one apparatus repair, and name the replay point.
Release only the exact digest accepted by standards and Editor; project labels, references, provenance, feeds, structured data, rights, and revenue separation.
Invalidate and repair every dependent page, feed, metadata, social, syndication, and archive projection while retaining visible lineage.
Measure discovery, usefulness, retention, trust, and revenue as product evidence while preserving the firewall between audience demand, advertising, and editorial warrant.

inductionRule: These are candidate service boundaries recovered from prior art and professional practice. A duty becomes a separately seated office or enterprise only when repeated live traces show an independently contractable obstruction, authority boundary, or reusable product; until then it remains a duty in the smallest existing owner.
firstReplay: Run the failed candidate through Sonnet Editor with the manuscript, full source records, exact writer-time packet when available, operative skills/scripts/configuration, and recovered newsroom research. Repair the earliest layer, replay from there, and publish only after a digest-matching independent acceptance.
